cases.task: Build a day-by-day itinerary for Lake George, NY for Thanksgiving week, November 26–28, 2026, for a group of six adults.

specialist.summary: Here is a three-day Lake George itinerary for Thanksgiving week, November 26–28, 2026, with community-listed stops that all need confirming as open on those dates because the listings state no season and November is typically off-season.

stops.title: Lake George Steamboat Company
stops.description: Considered by some locals to be Lake George's "claim to fame" is the authentic Steamboat Company, always a tourist attraction (so be ready for a crowd). Founded in 1817 as a commercial shipper, the company now has three passenger vessels for cruises up and dow… Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Mario's Restaurant
stops.description: This restaurant has been serving Italian cuisine since 1954. They also have a full-service bar. The restaurant is popular, so reservations are advised. Dinner is offered M-Th from 4:30PM, and Su from 3PM. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Adirondack Camp
stops.description: Historic summer camp founded in 1904 by Dr. Elias G. Brown, one of the oldest continually operating children's camps in the Adirondacks. The camp's waterfront peninsula on Blair's Bay, south of Anthony's Nose, is a notable landmark visible from the lake. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Sushi Yoshi
stops.description: This is a hibachi steakhouse that serves Chinese and Japanese food. The authentic low tables, which are situated over hollow pits, allow guests to dine in Japanese izakaya style. Lunch and dinner seven days a week. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Pizza Jerks
stops.description: Delicious New York-style pizzeria that serves, among other dishes, chicken wings and garlic knots. They also deliver. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Nina's Sweet Shop
stops.description: Nina's offers a variety of sweets such as fudge and taffy ice cream, and some are sugar free. This shop is a local favorite. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: The Rooftop Cabana Bar
stops.description: Outdoor dining on the shore of Lake George. Located on Surfside on the Lake's rooftop terrace with panoramic views. Offers a menu of appetizers, salads, sandwiches, paninis, burgers, and steak. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Gooney Golf
stops.description: This is a typical old-fashioned mini-golf, with the classic windmill-type obstacles. Confirm it's open on your dates.

cases.task: Build a day-by-day itinerary for Savannah, GA, April 9–11, 2027, for two adults who like history and food.

specialist.summary: Savannah's April 9–11, 2027 plan has three days of Wikivoyage history and food stops, such as Bonaventure Cemetery, Forsyth Park, River Street, and Desposito's, with each stop still needing confirmation that it is open on those dates.

stops.title: Bonaventure Cemetery
stops.description: Fans of "The Book" will find Johnny Mercer's grave here, along with those of Conrad Aiken and other Southern notables. The view of the river is wonderful, and the Spanish moss creates a delightfully spooky atmosphere. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Wormsloe Historic Site
stops.description: The entrance has a beautiful avenue of live oak trees, plus there is a visitor's center with history of the plantation and trails along the marshes. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Saint Bibiana
stops.description: In the Savannah Bardo Hotel. A fine Italian cuisine restaurant and cocktail lounge located in historic downtown Savannah, adorned with chic artwork, stunning chandeliering, and the full restoration and artistic touches of the original 1888 Savannah Mansion. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Forsyth Park
stops.description: This large public park, which marks the southern edge of the Historic District, is ringed with bed and breakfasts and crowned with a beautiful fountain. They filmed Midnight in the Garden of Good & Evil here. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Georgia State Railroad Museum
stops.description: Features several vintage pieces of rolling stock, an operating model train layout, and an operating turntable. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Desposito's
stops.description: One of the few surviving family-owned shrimp shacks from a previous era, with the same secret-recipe dipping sauce that they've used for more than half a century. Go for a taste of old-timey Southern boiled shrimp. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: The Collins Quarter at Forsyth
stops.description: The only restaurant inside Forsyth Park. Great brunch menu and atmosphere. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: City Market
stops.description: City Market is a mixed-use project in the northwest corner of the Historic District. The rehabilitation of the four-block area began in 1985. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: River Street
stops.description: A popular cobblestone street (one way east) along the south bank of the Savannah River. It is lined with numerous tourist-targeted shops and restaurants. Confirm it's open on your dates.

activities.title: Cuartel de Ballaja
activities.description: Completed in 1863, and in 1881 a chapel was added. This building housed military personnel and is now a museum called Las Americas Museum containing Caribbean and European American arts and artifacts.

activities.title: Museo de San Juan
activities.description: Museum on the history of San Juan.

activities.title: La Casa del Libro
activities.description: Museum of the art and history books through five centuries. A museum holding nearly 5,000 early works of manuscripts and books, some as from as old as the 15th century. This museum is most known for having two royal mandates signed by Ferdinand and Isabella co…

activities.title: El Asador, The Grill Old San Juan
activities.description: Puerto Rican cuisine at the entrance of Old San Juan, the heart of nightlife in the Old City. It is a two-level restaurant with an exterior patio.

activities.title: BUNS Burger Shop
activities.description: Great burgers with high quality beef. Over 40 beers, some on tap.

activities.title: Super Max
activities.description: A normal grocery store.

activities.title: Freshmart
activities.description: A natural foods-centric grocery store where, as you leave, you are wished to "have a healthy day!"

activities.title: La Bombonera
activities.description: Authentic local cuisine in an unassuming landmark atmosphere unchanged for decades. Serves lunch and dinner. Fresh pastries. Superlative coffee. Inexpensive.

activities.title: Ostra Cosa
activities.description: Reservations recommended. The ambience here is one of the most sensual and romantic in Old San Juan.
